result.summary: The page is largely functional and well structured. Findings are minor visual polish issues: inconsistent card sizing/alignment in the 'Fastest near you' carousel, an awkward decorative shape overlapping the promo banner, and a possibly truncated delivery address.

issues.description: The restaurant card images in the 'Fastest near you' row are not aligned to a consistent grid: the first card is noticeably narrower/shorter than the others, and its image and title appear misaligned with the adjacent cards.
issues.suggestion: Use a fixed card width and uniform aspect ratio for the images so all cards align on the same baseline and have equal height.

issues.description: The green promotional banner has a large translucent circular shape that is clipped and overlaps the text area, creating an inconsistent visual artifact on the right side of the banner.
issues.suggestion: Remove the overlapping decorative shape or position it so it does not intrude on the banner's content region.

issues.description: The delivery address label shows a partially truncated street name ('Weizenbergi 20') that may be cut off or misspelled, making the destination unclear.
issues.suggestion: Verify the address text and ensure the full street name renders without truncation.
